item.title: Lovlina Borgohain And Nikhat Zareen To Lead 20-member Indian Squad At Asian Boxing Championships 2026
item.description: Alfiya Tarannum Akram Khan Pathan: Olympic medallist Lovlina Borgohain and two-time world champion Nikhat Zareen will spearhead the 20-member Indian contingent at the Asian Boxing Championships 2026, scheduled to be held in Mongolia from March 28 to April 11.

item.title: T20 WC: How Pakistan Can Still Qualify For Semis -- Scenarios Explained
item.description: Pakistan must beat Sri Lanka by 64 runs or chase the target in 13.1 overs in their final Super 8 match at Pallekele to qualify for the T20 World Cup 2026 semifinals after England’s win over New Zealand reshaped Group 2 standings.

item.title: Atletico Closes Door On Possible Griezmann U.S. Move
item.description: Real Madrid Medical Services: Atletico Madrid's Director of Sport, Mateu Alemany, has closed the door on speculation that French international Antoine Griezmann is on the verge of leaving the club to sign for MLS side Orlando City.

item.title: England Women’s Hockey Team Reaches Hyderabad For FIH World Cup 2026 Qualifiers
item.description: FIH Hockey World Cup: The England women’s national hockey team has arrived in Hyderabad to participate in the upcoming FIH Hockey World Cup 2026 Qualifiers, taking place in Hyderabad, Telangana, from March 8 to 14.

item.title: T20 WC: We Do Not Really Care About The Perfect Game, Says Will Jacks
item.description: T20 World Cup: All-rounder Will Jacks believes England doesn’t need a “perfect game” to lift the 2026 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup title. Having sealed a semi-final berth with a thrilling last-over win over New Zealand in Colombo — his fourth Player-of-the-Match award of the tournament — Jacks made it clear that results, not perfection, were what mattered.

item.title: Olympians Jinson Johnson, Anish Bhanwala To Headline 63rd Fit India Sundays On Cycle Event
item.description: Dr Syama Prasad Mookerjee Swimming: Olympians Jinson Johnson and Anish Bhanwala will be the main highlights of the 63rd Fit India Sundays on Cycle event on March 1. Johnson, a former India Olympian in 2016 and the national record holder in the 1500m with a time of 3:35.24, will join the cycling event at the picturesque RK Beach in Visakhapatnam.

item.title: Ranji Trophy Final: ‘In Hubballi To Cheer The J&K; Cricket Team As They Seal A Historic Win,’ Says CM Abdullah
item.description: Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah: The Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah was in attendance watching the final of the Ranji Trophy between J&K and Karnataka on the final day at the Hubli Cricket Ground.

item.title: Prague Masters: Gukesh Loses To Van Foreest; Aravindh Draws To Parham
item.description: World Champion Gukesh Dommaraju: World Champion Gukesh Dommaraju suffered a shock defeat to Grand Master Jorden van Foreest on Saturday in round three of the 2026 Prague Chess Festival Masters.

item.title: T20 WC: ‘Added Responsibility To Entertain Them, We’ll Meet Soon,’ Says Samson On Chepauk Reception During IND Vs ZIM
item.description: MA Chidambaram Stadium: India wicketkeeper-batter Sanju Samson spoke about the overwhelming reception he received at the MA Chidambaram Stadium, his new home venue in the Indian Premier League (IPL), after being traded to Chennai Super Kings. The 29-year-old, who recently featured in India’s ICC Men’s T20 World Cup clash against Zimbabwe at the iconic venue, reflected on the emotional connection he felt with fans in Chennai and the added sense of responsibility that comes with their support.
